quest.title: Clock Island
quest.subtitle: Set the hands. Catch the rides. Finish your day.
quest.intro: Welcome aboard, time traveller! This island runs on clockwork — turn the hands to be everywhere on time and fill your journal with stamps.

stops.title: Ferry Pier
stops.brief: The morning ferry is warming its engine. Set the clock just right and climb aboard.

missions.prompt: The first ferry leaves at 9 o'clock. Turn the hands to 9:00.
missions.hint: At a full hour the minute hand points straight up at the 12, and the hour hand points at the 9.

missions.prompt: The next ferry is at half past nine. Set the clock to 9:30.
missions.hint: Minute hand points to 6 at half past.

missions.prompt: One more boat sails at quarter past ten. Set the clock to 10:15.
missions.hint: A quarter past means the minute hand has walked a quarter of the way round — to the 3.

stops.title: Salty Market
stops.brief: Bells, bread and busy stalls. Five-minute precision keeps the bakers happy.

missions.prompt: The baker pulls sea-salt loaves out at 10:25. Set the clock.
missions.hint: The minute hand points at the 5 — and each big number is 5 minutes.

missions.prompt: The juice cart opens at 10:40. Set the clock.
missions.hint: Count by fives up to the 8 — that makes 40 minutes past.

missions.prompt: The market bell rings at 11:55 — five minutes to noon. Set the clock.
missions.hint: 55 minutes is the 11 on the face — just one small step before the 12.

stops.title: Clang Station
stops.brief: Read the departure board like a real traveller, then set your watch by it.

missions.prompt: You want the train that leaves at quarter past one. Which one is it?
missions.hint: Quarter past one is 1:15. Read the minutes first, then the hour.

missions.prompt: Grandpa waits at Salt Marsh at three. Which train gets you there by quarter to three?
missions.hint: Quarter to three is 2:45 — the minute hand has 15 minutes left to reach the 12.

missions.prompt: Your train to Salt Marsh leaves at half past three. Set the clock.
missions.hint: Half past = the minute hand on the 6, the hour hand halfway between 3 and 4.

missions.prompt: The last afternoon train is the Old Mill train, at five past four. Set the clock.
missions.hint: Five past means one little step past the hour — the minute hand on the 1.

stops.title: Gullwing Lighthouse
stops.brief: Evening quarters only. The keeper trusts you with the big lamp.

missions.prompt: The keeper's supply boat leaves at quarter past seven. Which boat is it?
missions.hint: Quarter past seven is 7:15 — the same quarter as after noon, just in the evening.

missions.prompt: The keeper lights the first little lamp at half past six. Set the clock.
missions.hint: Half past six: the hour hand sits between 6 and 7, the minute hand on the 6.

missions.prompt: The gulls come home at quarter to seven. Set the clock.
missions.hint: Quarter to seven = 6:45. The minute hand points at the 9.

missions.prompt: The big beam sweeps the sea at half past eight. Set the clock one last time.
missions.hint: Half past eight: minute hand on the 6, hour hand between 8 and 9.

stops.title: Clocktower Green
stops.brief: Your journal is almost full. Pin each memory to the right part of the day.

missions.prompt: Pin each memory to the right part of the day: morning, midday or evening.
missions.hint: Morning comes first, midday is around 12 o'clock, and evening is when the lamps come on.
